summary: Sandbach United kicked off their 2026/27 season in style with a 3-1 victory over league newcomers Wednesfield, with Bevan scoring twice including a brilliant solo effort in the second half. The Ramblers showed impressive cohesion early on despite five new players in the starting lineup, and weathered a brief moment of adversity when they were temporarily down to ten men due to a substitution timing issue. It was a perfect start to the campaign with some great attacking play on display, and the club also unveiled several new sponsors ahead of the match.
